title: Malware on Phone | How to Check, Scan and Remove It on iPhone and Android (2026 Guide)
content_md: You can check a phone for malware by reviewing installed apps, permissions, battery and data usage, and unknown profiles, then running Google Play Protect on Android. To remove it, delete the suspicious App (in Safe Mode on Android), update the system, and factory reset if symptoms persist. iPhones are rarely infected, but they are not immune. Quick 5-Step Check Open your app list and look for anything you don’t recognize or don’t remember installing. Check battery and mobile data usage for apps that use far more than they should. Look for unknown configuration profiles (iPhone) or device admin and accessibility apps (Android). Update the operating system, and on Android, run a Google Play Protect scan. If the problem remains, uninstall the suspect App in Safe Mode on Android, or reset the phone as a last resort. What Is Malware on a Phone? Malware on a phone is malicious software that runs on a smartphone without the owner’s informed consent, built to steal data, take money, or control the device. Unlike a buggy app, it is designed to hide itself and to profit from the person who carries the phone.
